title: Vrooli Search Configuration
description: Scenario-owned AI-search SSOT (.vrooli/search.json): per-provider descriptor + tuning factors + evaluation corpus. Consumed by the scenario at boot (read tuning, self-register) and by search-hub (route, sweep, write-back). One file, one home — nothing search-tunable is a Go literal or a build-time seed.

description.description: Routing description: what to find here and when to route to it

reindex_endpoint.description: Secured control-plane target for the shared, token-gated search-hub.v1.control.SearchControlService reindex verbs (Reindex/ReindexStatus/ReindexCancel). Declared by a provider that exposes its corpus to the sweep; absent for routable-but-not-tunable providers.

config_endpoint.description: Secured control-plane target for the shared SearchControlService.WriteConfig verb (the sweep's write-back of a winning tuning block into this file). Token-gated; absent for providers that are not config-writable.

result_mapping.description: How to map the provider's response into normalized hits

endpoint.description: Opaque transport descriptor (interpreted by search-hub, not by aisearch-go).

tuning.description: Search tuning factors. Optional: a provider that omits this block runs on the aisearch-go defaults (TuningConfig.WithDefaults — dense engine, default embed model, no rerank), so an untuned provider is still valid. INDEX-TIME factors (engine, embed_model, embed_task_prefix) change the stored vectors and require a reindex when moved; QUERY-TIME factors (rerank_*, floor) vary per request. The sweep writes the winning values here. See packages/aisearch-go/tuning.go (the factor-taxonomy SSOT) for the per-factor tradeoff.

engine.description: INDEX-TIME. dense = dense-vector only; hybrid = dense + BM25 sparse RRF fusion. N/A for hybrid-by-construction adopters (e.g. knowledge-observatory.docs): when a provider's read+index path always builds a hybrid binding and exposes no config_endpoint, this field is a fixed invariant the engine pins — set it to "hybrid" to match reality; a divergent value is corrected with a warning at load.

embed_task_prefix.description: INDEX-TIME. Apply asymmetric search_query:/search_document: prefixes (nomic). Changes the embedding space → reindex.

rerank_enabled.description: QUERY-TIME. Gate the cross-encoder/LLM rerank pass.

rerank_blend.description: QUERY-TIME. Fuse rerank order with retrieval via RRF instead of reordering outright (requires rerank_enabled).

rerank_shortlist.description: QUERY-TIME. Over-fetch depth into the reranker.

floor.description: QUERY-TIME. Relevance-floor band (0 = let the package pick the regime default).

scoring.description: Corpus grading policy. Defaults apply when omitted: recall_at=5, recall_target=0.8, mrr_at=3, deep_k=50.

recall_target.description: Minimum accepted recall over reviewed, non-stale positives.

deep_k.description: Referential validation probe depth. Values below recall_at are resolved up to recall_at by the shared library.

tests.description: The evaluation corpus — the SSOT that search-hub's eval store mirrors. One labelled corpus per provider; one case list (negatives are cases with expect_no_strong_hit). Maps 1:1 onto the search-hub eval proto's EvalSuite (modulo store-assigned suite metadata), so a scenario self-registers it at boot and every mutation writes back here.

suite_id.description: Optional override for the default suite id '<provider_id>.primary' (only a provider with more than one suite needs it)

name.description: Human-facing suite name mirrored into the store

description.description: Human-facing suite description mirrored into the store

cases.description: The whole corpus: positive labelled queries AND negatives (a negative is a case with expect_no_strong_hit)

scope.description: Optional case-level query scope. Empty/default is global; scenario:<id> and path:<prefix> map to the shared SearchQuery scope.

status.description: Review state. Empty/default is reviewed; generated cases enter as candidate and are excluded from acceptance recall until promoted.

tags.description: Difficulty/category/provenance tags (e.g. 'strong', 'weak-real', 'hard', 'gibberish', 'generated'). 'generated' is the load-bearing marker the sweep holds out of the tuning fold.

expect_ids.description: Positive label: leaf ids (per the provider's id_field, e.g. 'restart') that should appear within expect_within_top_k

expect_within_top_k.description: The expected hit must land within this rank

expect_min_score.description: Optional single-regime floor for the expected hit. NOT set on rank-centric positives (cross-regime fairness).

expect_no_strong_hit.description: Negative: no result should exceed expect_max_score (junk-rejection case)
